name: Henry County, KY
findings: Henry County has 44 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (16%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, Henry County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Henry County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.
